images.filename: Inside of reconstructed Prisoner Barracks, Fort Delaware.jpg
images.caption: This is the inside of a typical Confederate Prisoner barracks, reconstructed. They were designed to house the Confederate prisoners three-high.  The closeness of the bunks contributed greatly to the many prisoners who died on the island, over 2700.  Most are buried in trenches at Finns Point National Cemetery, New Jersey.
images.alt: This is the inside of a typical Confederate Prisoner barracks, reconstructed. They were designed to house the Confederate prisoners three-high.  The closeness of the bunks contributed greatly to the many prisoners who died on the island, over 2700.  Most are buried in trenches at Finns Point National Cemetery, New Jersey.
